contracts.groups: Administrator-created canonical organizations/groups; individual and group host/project grants remain distinct. No automatic email/claim principal creation. Only configured issuer/exact claim-value mappings enroll existing canonical principals. OIDC and pinned custom signed assertions verify the configured bounded top-level group claim. Fresh membership evidence expires within60–86400seconds; missing configured claim clears that issuer membership.
contracts.live_authority: Role, trust, project grant, membership or mapping removals bump current principal policy and revoke affected device sessions. Expired memberships no longer confer scopes, roles/project grants or collection authority. Session, current-principal, owned-resource, collection and live WS transport paths use current durable group policy. Individual project grants survive group expiry. Renewing an expired issuer membership revokes prior device sessions even when the freshly verified group identifiers match the expired rows.
contracts.organizations: Organizations are canonical administrator-owned affiliation metadata attached to configured groups; tenant OS isolation is not inferred.
contracts.audit: Administrator-only inspect/save/prune endpoints. Days, byte and record limits apply immediately on save, on bounded writes and a once-per-UTC-day expiry sweep on subsequent audit writes. Private atomic policy/log files, nested sensitive-key and URL credential redaction. Query uses bounded streaming/retained deque rather than whole-file text load; legacy reads cap64MiB and1000 records.
contracts.frontend: Access children use existing manager form styling. Group revision reload preserves dirty draft, requires current conflict review before saving exactrevision. Retention removal requires explicit acknowledgement; no provider/account activation implied. Deferred replies across Lock/unlock and actual unmount cannot reset dirty group or retention drafts; locking clears retention acknowledgment.
